title: A^3-CodGen: A Repository-Level Code Generation Framework for Code Reuse with Local-Aware, Global-Aware, and Third-Party-Library-Aware
note: Full text (arxiv html): local context via AST-extracted signatures, global context via dual embedding-similarity retrieval of top-k functions, libs as names only; k-ablation (1/5/10/15) vs vanilla baseline, not budget-matched.

title: Repoformer: Selective Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Completion
note: Full text: LM self-triggers/abstains from retrieving cross-file code chunks via learned special token; Table2 compares No/Always/Selective retrieval at matched model size but unequal context length, so not strict budget-matching.

title: STALL+: Boosting LLM-based Repository-level Code Completion with Static Analysis
note: Full text: static-analysis-extracted cross-file class/method signatures and valid-name lists prepended to raw in-file text; truncation equalizes window across their own phase-integration variants but no matched-budget baseline vs no-context.

title: CKGFuzzer: LLM-Based Fuzz Driver Generation Enhanced By Code Knowledge Graph
note: Full text: code knowledge graph (function/file nodes, CALLS/LIBRARY_CALLS edges, no explicit dataflow) queried and chunks iteratively refined; ablation (text-only vs graph retrieval) holds fuzzing CPU-time constant, not LLM token budget.

title: RepoScope: Leveraging Call Chain-Aware Multi-View Context for Repository-Level Code Generation
note: Full text: Repository Structural Semantic Graph (callers/call chains) plus similarity-retrieved functions/fragments both feed the prompt via deterministic static analysis; per-component removal ablation reports token-count deltas but doesn't equalize budget.

title: SWE-QA: Can Language Models Answer Repository-level Code Questions?
note: Full text: benchmark compares direct-prompting, embedding-RAG chunks, and agentic tool-use (OpenHands/SWE-agent file+terminal tools) as context-augmentation strategies; agent uses ~100x tokens of RAG, so unmatched budget.

title: In Line with Context: Repository-Level Code Generation via Context Inlining
note: Full text: call-graph (Tree-Sitter/Pydepcall) traversal selects caller/callee raw source to inline around a draft anchor, no signatures/graph serialized into prompt; component-removal ablation (w/o upstream/downstream/draft), no token-budget control reported.

title: Automated Customization of LLMs for Enterprise Code Repositories Using Semantic Scopes
note: Full text: 'semantic scopes' are raw bracket-delimited code chunks retrieved via embedding cosine-similarity for the RAG variant (vs a separate fine-tuning variant); comparison is against baseline models of differing capacity, not budget-matched.

title: Context Pruning for Coding Agents via Multi-Rubric Latent Reasoning
note: Full text: CRF-based multi-rubric (semantic evidence + dependency support) keep/prune scoring over raw token/line context, AST used only for training labels/repair; paper states 'all methods are evaluated under matched compression constraints'.

title: Agent4cs: A Multi-agent System for Code Summarization in Large Hierarchical Codebases
note: Full text: multi-agent bottom-up function-level then folder-level hierarchical summarization builds a repo overview; quantified vs 2 structured-prompting baselines but summary lengths vary widely (200-800+ words), unmatched budget.

title: Agent Retrieval Bench: Evaluating Repository Context Retrieval for Coding Agents
note: Full text: benchmarks lexical/dense-embedding retrieval, RepoMap (structural skeleton) and logged agentic trajectories as co-primary, no family dominates; explicit budgeted-context-yield (BCY@4k/8k/16k/32k) comparison across representations.
